newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley calls 8.88 pct preferred.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley calls 8.88 pct preferred.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said it called for redemption all 975,000 outstanding shares of its 8.88 percent cumulative preferred stock and all of the preferred stock's corresponding depositary shares.
The preferred stock will be redeemed at a price of $201.632 per share, and is worth $25.204 per depositary share, at current prices, the company said.
That amount equals all dividends accrued and accumulated and unpaid up to -- but excluding -- January 3, it added.
The company will mail notice of the redemption to depositary shareholders on record as of December 3.
